direction: Graphite field console: a calm, legible, evidence-led city demo. Preserve the global left navigation and the established neutral graphite/teal system; improve the guided story, not a wholesale unrelated visual theme.
interpretation: One consistent spacing rhythm across sidebar, workspace header, media, result strip and forms
Fewer competing borders and duplicated actions
Make the primary demo action and scenario meaning readable from across a booth
newFeatures: Scenario selection explains problem, watch point, value and research before an explicit Start demo action
Guarded preparation screen with the chosen problem, truthful phases and a stop action
Operational context and research sources alongside each measurement topic
One event-time evidence replay action distinct from current-camera Ask
Guided search examples and useful empty states
A local edge-workflow page and downloadable deployment discussion brief, with no fabricated capacity or ROI claims
invariants: Actual live frames remain the media; generated UI concepts are design only
No invented observed metric, completed crossing, successful clearance or accuracy percentage
No fake time-progress, fake service status, cloud-free claim beyond verified selected local execution, or hardware sizing promise
Uncertainty, lost tracks and source scope remain present, with details progressively disclosed
Native rendering/preparation/capture/streaming guards and memory reserve remain enabled
No unrequested messages or publishing to third parties
